items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: he willed his eyes to a friend of ours, Boyce Brown

ctx.x: No, Richard had rheumatic fever when he was a young kid and he had what they call leakage of the heart which is a bad valve you know. And he died, oh gosh, let's see, fifteen years ago. A lot of courage this guy had. He willed his eyes to an eye bank and his organs even that long ago. Actually he willed his eyes to a friend of ours, Boyce Brown who was a saxophone player who became a brother in some, what do you call them, monks? Brother something, I can't remember, but Boyce Brown.
And Boyce Brown is on one of the albums we have, the Chicago jazz album. An excellent saxophone player. What more do you want to know about my vital statistics?
